title: Photo Artists' Books
name: Photo Artists' Books
credit: Paula McCartney. Courtesy of the artist.

body.html: Books can be a dynamic and intimate way to share your work and offer a viewing experience that is not tied to a specific time and location. This class will focus on the sequencing, construction, and study of photo-based artist books. I will share the process of creating my books and some favorite books from my collection. Basic bindings that work well with photographs will be demonstrated.  Students will receive feedback during the class on a book in progress or a series of images that are ready to be sequenced and bound.
